name: Passive Voice, Indirect Speech & Complex Prepositional Verbs

topics.title: Passive Voice (Voix Passive) Formation & Agent Prepositions
topics.objective: Transform active sentences into the passive voice across multiple tenses, selecting correct agent prepositions (*par* vs *de*).

topics.title: Passive Tense Variations & Pronominal Passive Alternatives
topics.objective: Master passive voice across compound/modal tenses and utilize natural pronominal passive alternatives (*se faire*, *se voir*, *se + verb*).

exercises.es: Bob cobra 3 dólares por hora por cortar el césped.
exercises.fr: Bob se faisait payer 3 dollars de l'heure pour tondre la pelouse.

topics.title: Indirect Speech (Discours Indirect) Tense Shifts in Past Contexts
topics.objective: Convert direct statements into indirect speech after past matrix reporting verbs, applying obligatory backshifting tense rules.

topics.title: Indirect Questions & Imperatives in Indirect Speech
topics.objective: Transform direct interrogatives and imperatives into indirect reporting clauses using *si, ce que, ce qui*, interrogative adverbs, and *de + infinitive*.

topics.objective: Master B2-level verbal governing structures requiring preposition *de* before infinitive complements or nominal objects.

topics.title: Expressions of Cause & Consequence (Expression de Cause et Conséquence)
topics.objective: Formulate complex argumentative sentences expressing logical causality and consequence using advanced connectors (*puisque, grâce à, à cause de, c'est pourquoi, par conséquent*).
